# Country/Any scope. Pure O(1) Five-Dimensional Empire Entropy calculators & readout values.

# Calendar month index since 1337.1 (used for same-month deduplication var:oe_ent_ran_m).
oe_ent_m_now = {
    value = current_year
    subtract = 1337
    multiply = 12
    add = current_month
}

# Country scope. Counts started R3B Romanization campaigns on BYZ/ROM (0..8, O(1) var checks).
oe_ent_assim_score = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_rw_turkish_romanization_started } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_rw_bulgaria_romanization_started } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_rw_serbia_romanization_started } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_rw_illyria_romanization_started } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_rw_latin_romanization_started } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_rw_egypt_romanization_started } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_rw_syria_romanization_started } add = 1 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_rw_pentarchy_romanization_started } add = 1 }
}

# Country scope. Low-loyalty Themes / Exarchates (loyalty band <= 1; iterates only own subjects, capped at 4).
oe_ent_low_loyal_themes = {
    value = 0
    every_subject = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty_band
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty_band } var:oe_theme_loyalty_band <= 1 }
        }
        add = 1
    }
    max = 4
}

# ---- Dimension 1: Overextension & Administrative Decay (cached monthly to var:oe_ent_d1_overext)
# Formula: +(owned - 150) / 250 (0..+2.5), offset by oe_prf_strain_relief, oe_ar_exarchate, capital path,
# Yuan restored Secretariat, Russian Guberniya reforms, and Imperial Inspectorate decision.
oe_ent_calc_d1 = {
    value = num_locations
    subtract = 150
    divide = 250
    min = 0
    max = 2.50
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ent_is_byz_or_rom = yes }
        # Praetorian Prefectures & 12 Dioceses relief (already negative, capped at -1.50 here)
        add = { value = oe_prf_strain_relief min = -1.50 max = 0 }
        # Exarchates of Ravenna / Carthage (-0.45 each, up to -0.90)
        add = { value = oe_ar_exarch_count max = 2 multiply = -0.45 }
        # Capital settlement choice from oe_ar (Rome -0.25, Dual Capitals -0.35)
        if = { limit = { var:oe_ar_path ?= 3 } add = -0.35 }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_ar_path ?= 2 } add = -0.25 }
    }
    if = { limit = { oe_ent_yuan_restored = yes } add = -0.35 }
    if = { limit = { oe_ent_rus_reformed = yes } add = -0.35 }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ent_mod_admin_inspect } add = -0.60 }
    min = -1.20
    max = 2.50
}

# ---- Dimension 2: Monetary & Silver Price Revolution Shock (cached monthly to var:oe_ent_d2_inflation)
# EU5 inflation scale is fractional (0.05 = 5%, 0.10 = 10%, 0.20 = 20%).
oe_ent_calc_d2 = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { inflation >= 0.20 } add = 0.90 }
    else_if = { limit = { inflation >= 0.10 } add = 0.50 }
    else_if = { limit = { inflation >= 0.05 } add = 0.20 }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { gold < 0 num_loans >= 3 } }
        add = 0.40
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { monthly_balance < 0 }
        add = 0.20
    }
    if = {
        limit = { current_year >= 1550 inflation >= 0.04 }
        add = 0.30
    }
    if = { limit = { oe_ent_yuan_baochao_ok = yes } add = -0.30 }
    if = { limit = { oe_ent_yuan_silver_ok = yes } add = -0.25 }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ent_mod_currency_reform } add = -0.65 }
    min = -0.50
    max = 1.60
}

# ---- Dimension 3: Frontier Satrapy & Governor Warlordism (cached monthly to var:oe_ent_d3_satrapy)
oe_ent_calc_d3 = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ent_is_byz_or_rom = yes }
        add = { value = oe_ent_low_loyal_themes multiply = 0.30 }
        add = { value = oe_prf_mil_prefectures max = 4 multiply = 0.20 }
        add = { value = oe_prf_civil_prefectures max = 3 multiply = -0.15 }
    }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { stability < 0 } add = 0.65 }
        else_if = { limit = { stability < 20 } add = 0.35 }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ent_mod_admin_inspect } add = -0.50 }
    min = -0.50
    max = 1.50
}

# ---- Dimension 4: Cultural & Religious Overload (cached monthly to var:oe_ent_d4_culture)
# EU5 religious_unity scale is fractional (0.50 = 50%, 0.65 = 65%, 0.80 = 80%).
oe_ent_calc_d4 = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { religious_unity < 0.50 } add = 0.85 }
    else_if = { limit = { religious_unity < 0.65 } add = 0.50 }
    else_if = { limit = { religious_unity < 0.80 } add = 0.25 }
    if = { limit = { num_locations >= 300 } add = 0.30 }
    else_if = { limit = { num_locations >= 200 } add = 0.15 }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ent_is_byz_or_rom = yes }
        add = { value = oe_ent_assim_score max = 6 multiply = -0.10 }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ent_mod_tolerance_charter } add = -0.60 }
    min = -0.50
    max = 1.20
}

# ---- Dimension 5: Multi-Front Warfare & Hegemonic Fatigue (cached monthly to var:oe_ent_d5_war)
# Peacetime baseline: -2.0/month + high stability (>= 50) -1.0/month.
oe_ent_calc_d5 = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = { at_war = yes }
        add = 0.50
        if = { limit = { war_exhaustion >= 8 } add = 1.00 }
        else_if = { limit = { war_exhaustion >= 4 } add = 0.60 }
        else_if = { limit = { war_exhaustion >= 2 } add = 0.30 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = oe_ent_war_months
                trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ent_war_months } var:oe_ent_war_months >= 36 }
            }
            add = 0.30
        }
    }
    else = {
        add = -2.00
        if = { limit = { stability >= 50 } add = -1.00 }
        else_if = { limit = { stability < 0 } add = 0.60 }
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_ent_mod_amnesty_peace } add = -0.80 }
    }
    min = -3.80
    max = 2.10
}

# ---- Net Monthly Delta (reads cached d1..d5; applies Hardcore +35% and Pax Imperialis -25% on positive growth)
oe_ent_calc_net_delta = {
    value = 0
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ent_d1_overext } add = var:oe_ent_d1_overext }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ent_d2_inflation } add = var:oe_ent_d2_inflation }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ent_d3_satrapy } add = var:oe_ent_d3_satrapy }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ent_d4_culture } add = var:oe_ent_d4_culture }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ent_d5_war } add = var:oe_ent_d5_war }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_rule_is_empire_entropy_hardcore = yes }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = oe_ent_raw_pos
                trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ent_raw_pos } var:oe_ent_raw_pos >= 1 }
            }
            multiply = 1.35
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_country_modifier = oe_ent_pax_imperialis
            has_variable = oe_ent_raw_pos
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_ent_raw_pos } var:oe_ent_raw_pos >= 1 }
        }
        multiply = 0.75
    }
}

}
